Your website traffic report is ready

Open Traffic Report

Anyone with this link can view the spreadsheet. No Google sign-in is required.

parameters.content:
## SETUP BEFORE FIRST RUN
1. Edit **CONFIG - Edit These Values**.
2. Add the GA4 Property ID and exact Search Console property.
3. Add comma-separated report recipients and the SMTP sender address.
4. Select the same **Google OAuth2 API** credential in every HTTP Request node.
5. Add the Drive File scope and enable Google Drive API.
6. Select an SMTP credential in **Email Report Link**.
7. Run manually once. The report is shared as Anyone with the link — Viewer, then emailed.

The scheduled trigger runs every Monday at 8:00 AM using your n8n workflow timezone.
